jobs.title: Project Manager HCI
jobs.description:
Company Description

Founded in 1961, WWF works to help people and nature thrive. As a global conservation organization, WWF operates in more than 100 countries, partnering with communities, companies, and governments to protect wildlife, conserve vital habitats, and advance sustainable solutions. Grounded in science and driven by collaboration, WWF works to help nature by conserving biodiversity, supporting resilient communities, and addressing climate change. Nearly 1 million people in the United States and more than 5 million globally are WWF members.

Project Description

The Heart of Conservation Initiative
( HCI
) is a 5-year
global project
designed to address systemic barriers that limit Indigenous Peoples’ and local communities’ ability to steward their lands, territories, waters, and biodiversity-rich ecosystems. Despite strong evidence that Indigenous Peoples and local communities manage or influence at least 37% of remaining natural lands globally, they receive less than 1% of international climate and biodiversity finance, face complex donor procedures, limited direct access to funding, and insufficient recognition in decision-making arenas.  

Building on the achievements of the GEF-7 Inclusive Conservation Initiative (ICI), HCI’s objective is to increase Indigenous Peoples’ and local communities’ organizational capacities and ability to access sustainable finance at scale for territorial stewardship to deliver social, economic, cultural, and Global Environmental Benefits. The project is transformative in that it targets structural change in biodiversity finance systems—shifting from centralized, intermediary-driven models toward more inclusive, Indigenous Peoples and local community-led financing and governance mechanisms. 

This will be achieved through four integrated components: (i) organizational and technical self-strengthening of Indigenous Peoples and local community funds and organizations and implementation of self-determined Indigenous Peoples- and local community-led sub-projects across Latin America, Africa, and Asia; (ii) collective self-strengthening of Indigenous Peoples and local community-led funds and organizations’ institutional, fiduciary, and technical capacities; (iii) enhancing Indigenous Peoples' and local communities’ representation and influence in global biodiversity and biodiversity finance processes; (iv) advancing knowledge, learning, and evidence on rights-based, inclusive conservation; and (v) monitoring and evaluation.

Job Description

LOCATION: This position will be based in Brazil, Kenya, or Cambodia.

Major Function

The Project Manager will lead the GCU’s support for the HCI partners and ensure successful delivery of all components. They will supervise staff in a Global Coordination Unit (GCU), provide day-to-day management of the project and, with support from the Partner Liaison, coordinate with ten (10)  Component 1 Partners, and partners and specialists in Components 2 through 5.  This is a unique role managing and representing a global, Indigenous-led project that should respond both to Indigenous Peoples and local community partners’ priorities as well as meet GEF requirements. 

The Project Manager will report to the Senior Director, Conservation Areas, and Senior Director, Inclusive Conservation (Project Co-Leads)

Key Responsibilities

 Technical Delivery of Project Components:  
Component 1: Work with Component 1 partners to review and approve their annual work plans and budgets, provide technical inputs to their on-the-ground work, as needed, and support their self-strengthening plans.    
Component 2: Lead and coordinate delivery of Component 2 with GCU staff support; Work with Component 1 partners to identify common capacity-strengthening needs and develop and implement a collective strengthening program.  
Component 3: Lead and coordinate delivery of Component 3 with GCU staff support; Design and implement the Youth Policy Leaders program and work with Component 1 and 2 partners to identify policy processes and to enable effective, HCI-supported engagement therein.  
Support GCU staff to ensure successful delivery of Components 4 and 5.
 Project Management: 
Day-to-day management, monitoring, and evaluation of project activities and results as outlined in the CERDoc, Grant Agreement, and Annual Work Plan and Budget to achieve the project objective and targets in the Results Framework. 

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:  

Ensure that the GCU holds regular virtual meetings with Component 1 (C1) partners and as required with additional partners involved in the other components,  
Manage the workflow for the Indigenous Global Steering Committee (IGSC), in collaboration with the Project Co-Leads. 
In collaboration with all project sub-grantees and partners, develop the Annual Work Plan and Budget (AWPB) for the global HCI for each project year, for no-objection from the WWF GEF Agency and approval by the IGSC.  
Share C1 Partners’ annual workplans and budgets for no-objection from WWF GEF Agency and for IGSC information.  Provide high-level oversight and monitoring of procurement and expenditure in line with the AWPB in collaboration with the Finance and Operations (FO) Manager.
Review progress of work plan and monitoring plan in collaboration with the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Officer.  
Responsible for organization of inception workshop and other critical project workshops and meetings. 
Manage the design and maintenance of a project website, and the development and implementation of a communications strategy in collaboration with the Communications and Knowledge Management (CKM) Officer. 
Provide support for project implementation support and learning visits and internal and external reviews/evaluations with relevant GCU staff.
Support the MEL Officer to organize annual reflection workshops to identify lessons learned and propose potential changes for adaptive management to ensure project results and indicator targets are reached. 
Troubleshoot with GCU staff, component partners and Project co-leads to address challenges and create enabling conditions for trusting partnerships and project success.
Maintain a project risk register, including identification of risks to project success and development of mitigation measures in coordination with C1 partners and other project partners.  
Prepare and execute a project exit plan, including hand-off of project equipment and resources, close of grants and agreements, consultations and communications with project partners and interested parties, and ensure sustainability of project results. 
Champion the promise and achievements of the project, elevating its contributions to systems change and Indigenous Peoples and local community-led partners whenever possible. 
Any other tasks that are relevant to the assignment.
Staff management: 
Supervise the GCU staff including MEL Officer (crosscutting, especially components 1, 4 and 5), FO Manager (crosscutting), Environmental and Social Safeguards Officer (crosscutting, especially component 1), Gender Equality and Social Inclusion Officer (crosscutting , especially component 1), CKM Officer (crosscutting, especially components 2 and 4), Logistics and Administrative Assistant (crosscutting), and any other directly recruited staff or consultants.
Prepare TORs to recruit consultants, staff and sub-contracts in consultation with Project Co-Leads and for no-objection from WWF GEF Agency. 
Reporting: 
Collaborate with the MEL Officer to aggregate information from Component 1 Partner sub-projects and formulate semi-annual Project Progress Reports and ensure timely delivery to the WWF GEF Agency. 
Prepare workshop reports following the inception and other critical project workshops.
Collaborate with the FO Manager to oversee the preparation and disbursement of sub-grants to Component 1 partners and grants and agreements under the other 4 components.  
Collaborate with the FO Manager to aggregate financial information from C1 Partners and oversee the development of quarterly financial reports and ensure timely delivery to the WWF GEF Agency. 
Collaborate with the WWF network and partners to ensure co-finance reporting on a yearly basis. 
Prepare a Project Close Report.  
Quality Assurance: 
Provide quality assurance for project activities, including sub-grants. 
Provide quality assurance through review of reports and other products from partners, technical specialists, consultants, and staff.
Ensure implementation in line with the GEF and WWF standards and policies. 
Week-long, international travel may be expected on approximately a quarterly basis. 
Partnerships: 
Coordinate with co-financed projects and liaise with project partners to ensure co-financing commitments are realized.  
Attract additional partners and co-financing. 
Ensure smooth coordination and communication among all project partners, and with the Component 1 partners (the latter in collaboration with Partner Liaison). 
Manage stakeholder engagement and ensure gender and social inclusion considerations are fully integrated throughout project implementation in collaboration with the Social and Environmental Safeguards (ESS) and Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) Officers.  
Represent the project at conferences, meetings, and workshops. 

Qualifications

Key Competencies

Strategic Collaboration and Leadership. Able to lead and influence large and highly dispersed teams and coalitions, dealing with risk mitigation and conflict management.
Intercultural and adaptive management skills 
Results-oriented project management
Collaboration
Cross-cultural communication

Skills And Abilities

10 years of technical working experience, including at least five years of project management experience.  
Bachelor’s Degree; post-graduate degree in a relevant field preferred. 
At least five years’ experience supporting and working in solidarity with Indigenous people and local community organizations, and a demonstrated track record of culturally sensitive and respectful, community-centered collaboration with Indigenous Peoples and local communities.
Demonstrated ability to interact with Indigenous peoples and local community representatives, senior government, NGO, business, and donor staff. 
Experience with the Convention on Biological Diversity and/or other multilateral agreements and processes, focusing on biodiversity, Indigenous peoples’ and local communities’ rights, and finance. 
Experience delivering technical and financial reporting to donor agencies on large projects. 
Experience managing similar, complex, multi-stakeholder and multi-country projects.
Experience leading a team of staff and coordinating sub-grant partners, ideally across multiple time zones and cultures.  
Technical experience and knowledge in the thematic area of the project, such as Indigenous -led territorial stewardship, community-based sustainable development, etc.   
Knowledge of the Open Standards for the Practice of Conservation, or WWF Project and Program Management Standards, preferred. 
Experience with GEF Projects and GEF knowledge an advantage. 
Written and spoken fluency in English required; advanced proficiency in Spanish, French, or Portuguese – highly preferred.   

Additional Information

Location

The position will be based in Brazil, Cambodia or Kenya.

If applying to work in Brazil or Kenya, applicants must be nationals legally authorized to work in Brazil or Kenya. Employment visa sponsorship and relocation are not provided for Brazil or Kenya.

PLEASE NOTE: If applying to work in Cambodia, nationals from South and Southeast Asian countries who are willing to relocate to Cambodia may also apply, and WWF-Cambodia may be able to support visa sponsorship and relocation costs based on available budget.

Please note:
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the job's location.
Position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Information Technology Program Manager
jobs.description:
RBox International Solutions, Inc. is a Philippines-based organization providing business and operational support services. We are currently hiring for an IT Program Manager or Senior IT Project Manager
to support enterprise technology initiatives and collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders.

Work Arrangement:
Full-time | Permanent Night Shift (9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT) | Work From Home

Position Overview

The Senior Program Manager
leads a portfolio of concurrent technology projects across software engineering, ERP, CRM, system integration, and compliance. This role translates business priorities into delivery plans, manages dependencies across teams and vendors, and reports progress and risks directly to executive leadership.
The Senior Program Manager sets delivery standards for the team, coaches Technical Project Managers, strengthens PMO practices, and helps establish a developing PMO. This is a fully remote position reporting to U.S.-based IT leadership, with a fixed night shift aligned with U.S. business hours.
Responsibilities
Portfolio Delivery:
Lead multiple concurrent technology projects, manage cross-team dependencies, and deliver committed outcomes on time and within scope.
Planning and Estimation:
Ensure documented project plans are established in Azure DevOps (ADO) before development begins. Review estimates, balance team capacity, and recommend project sequencing when priorities compete.
Executive Reporting:
Prepare weekly executive status reports and quarterly business reviews. Provide evidence-based RAG ratings, highlight business impact, and identify decisions requiring leadership attention.
Intake and Scope Control:
Manage incoming requests and changing priorities. Evaluate tradeoffs, implement change control, and communicate recommendations with clear alternatives.
Risk and Escalation:
Proactively identify portfolio risks, escalate concerns with actionable recommendations, and drive timely resolution.
Vendor and Partner Management:
Oversee delivery vendors and implementation partners, including statements of work (SOWs), milestones, acceptance criteria, and performance management.
Requirements and Solution Alignment:
Collaborate with business owners, business systems analysts, and engineering teams to define business requirements, align solutions, and establish acceptance and launch criteria.
Delivery Metrics:
Define and monitor delivery KPIs using ADO data, including on-time delivery, scope changes, carryover, and cycle time.
Regulated Delivery:
Incorporate regulatory and compliance requirements, including SOC 2 and applicable industry standards, into project plans, change control, documentation, and audit processes.
Coaching and PMO Standards:
Mentor Technical Project Managers in planning, ADO practices, and reporting. Improve PMO templates, intake processes, and performance metrics.
Automation and AI:
Drive automation initiatives for recurring PMO activities, including AI-assisted status reporting and dashboards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 6 years of project management experience in IT, software, or technology, including 3 years managing multiple concurrent projects or cross-functional programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise technology projects, including ERP, CRM, or system integrations.
Advanced proficiency in Azure DevOps or Jira, including portfolio backlogs, queries, and dashboards.
Experience presenting project updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Experience managing vendors, SOWs, milestones, and project acceptance.
Experience coaching or mentoring project managers.
Hands-on experience in project planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting.
Willingness to work a fixed night shift, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time, with at least 12 months of continuous prior night shift experience.
Reliable home internet connection of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet, and a dedicated private workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or PgMP certification, along with PSM or SAFe certification.
Experience delivering ERP, CRM, EDI, or data platform programs.
Experience working in regulated industries, including pharmaceutical distribution, or with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and DSCSA.
Experience developing Power BI dashboards using ADO data.
Experience establishing or improving PMO practices, including project intake, templates, governance, and KPIs.
Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for project management, reporting, and automation.

Why Join Us?

Help shape and strengthen a developing Project Management Office.
Collaborate directly with U.S.-based IT leadership and gain exposure to executive stakeholders.
Manage a diverse portfolio of enterprise technology, integration, and compliance initiatives.
Explore professional growth opportunities toward PMO leadership.
Work with modern project management, analytics, and AI-assisted reporting tools.
Enjoy a fully remote work arrangement.

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

jobs.title: Transformation Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, the global leader in technology-enabled claims and risk management solutions,
is actively looking for a Transformation Program Manager
for an AI-enabled software delivery transformation focused on applying AI to software delivery practices. This role is 100% remote but candidates must be able to work CST!

***This is a 12 month contract with the opportunity to extend based on performance and business needs***

This initiative will use a phased pilot-team approach
to evaluate how AI can improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and create measurable cost savings. This Program Manager will work with business, technology, engineering, offshore teams, vendors, internal AI leadership, and senior stakeholders to shape and execute the AI-enabled delivery model.
This role requires a hands-on program leader who can operate in ambiguity, create structure where the path is still being defined, drive decisions, remove obstacles, and keep the initiative moving toward measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

Lead planning and delivery for the AI-enabled software delivery transformation, including workstreams where the process, operating model, or implementation path is still evolving.

Drive day-to-day execution across pilot teams, stakeholders, vendors, and offshore engineering partners.

Work with leadership to select the most suitable projects and pilot teams for applying the AI-enabled delivery model.

Build and manage the integrated project plan, including training, pilot execution, testing, adoption, measurement, and reporting.
Clarify ownership, frame options and tradeoffs, drive decisions, and escalate issues when needed.
Track milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and action items through resolution.
Help turn the AI-enabled delivery approach into practical guidance, documentation, and repeatable ways of working.
Provide clear status updates, risks, issues, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Support benefit tracking for productivity improvements, cost savings, resource usage, and AI-related consumption costs.

Required Qualifications

8+ years as a Technical Project Manager leading software development, IT transformation, or enterprise technology initiatives.

5+ years managing SDLC-based projects, including planning, development, testing, implementation, and adoption.

5+ years leading cross-functional enterprise delivery across business, technical, vendor, and offshore teams.

3+ years supporting transformation initiatives, pilot programs, phased rollouts, or process implementations.

Proven ability to lead ambiguous or first-time initiatives where requirements, processes, stakeholders, or implementation approaches are still evolving.
Strong project planning, coordination, risk management, and executive-level reporting skills.
Ability to translate strategic goals into actionable plans and drive execution across multiple stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in AI, automation, developer productivity tools, or AI-enabled software delivery.

Familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, Agile, or technology operating model transformation.
Demonstrated success measuring productivity gains, cost savings, resource efficiency, or business benefits tied to technology initiatives.
Exposure to portfolio management, project financials, budget planning, or vendor strategy.
Large enterprise IT environment experience.
Strong experience with Smartsheet and other PM tools.

jobs.description:
Location:
Remote or Hybrid

2 to 3 days a week onsite in Newark, DE

Join Our Team as a Dynamic Project Manager – Lead Engineering Projects with Impact!

Are you an organized, proactive leader with a passion for overseeing complex engineering projects? Do you thrive in collaborative environments and excel at managing multidisciplinary teams? If so, we want you to be our next Project Manager — the driving force behind successful projects and lasting client relationships!

About The Role

As a Project Manager, you will be at the heart of our engineering endeavors, owning client accounts, strategizing project workflows, and ensuring smooth execution from inception to completion. Your leadership will directly influence the quality, efficiency, and profitability of our projects, making a tangible difference in healthcare, pharmaceutical, and commercial sectors. This is more than project management — it’s about building trusted partnerships and delivering excellence every step of the way.

Key Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience managing engineering or multidisciplinary projects
Exceptional organizational and communication skills
Strong ability to develop and manage detailed project plans
Proficiency with project management software, particularly Monday.com and Teams
Ability to translate external communication into actionable tasks
Skilled in coordinating with discipline leads and managing internal QA/QC processes
Adept at scheduling, prioritizing, and maintaining project momentum

Nice To Have Skills & Experience

Background in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or complex commercial facilities
Experience with BIM coordination and construction administration
Familiarity with Bluebeam review sessions and construction phase workflows
Knowledge of equipment load calculations and engineering data management
Previous client relationship management or business development experience

Preferred Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical field
Several years of proven project management experience in engineering or design environments
Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and managing large-scale projects in specialized sectors is highly desirable

Additional Requirements

Ability to travel as needed for client meetings or project site visits
Certifications such as PMP, LEED, or relevant engineering licenses are a plus

If you’re ready to lead impactful projects, foster meaningful client relationships, and thrive in a collaborative team environment, we encourage you to apply now! Put your expertise to work with a company that values your leadership and supports your professional growth.

How To Apply

We’d love to see your resume, but we don’t need it to have a conversation. Send us an email to emily@scientificsearch.com and tell us why you’re interested. Or feel free to email your resume. Please include Job# 19821.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager – Networking NPI
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead New Product Introduction (NPI) for networking across Nscale's US GPU cloud. You'll own the path from a new network platform, architecture, or vendor being selected to it being proven, documented, and ready to deploy at scale.

That covers new switch and NIC generations, 800G and next-generation optics, new cluster fabric designs, and new data center and WAN reference architectures. You'll work closely with Network Architecture and Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, vendors, and our Deployment organization, which takes what you qualify and builds it across our sites. The role involves some travel to vendor labs and US pilot sites.

What You'll be Doing

Own the NPI program for new networking platforms, from vendor selection and early samples through lab qualification, pilot build, and release to Deployment.
Build NPI plans with clear phase gates (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), entry and exit criteria, owners, and dates.
Drive qualification and validation of switches, NICs/DPUs, optics, cables, and network operating systems, including interoperability, performance, burn-in, and failure testing.
Run the vendor engagement on new products: roadmap alignment, sample allocation, bug and RMA tracking, firmware and NOS release readiness, and escalation of blocking defects.
Partner with Network Architecture to turn new designs into production-ready reference builds, golden configs, BOMs, cabling and rack standards, and acceptance test plans.
Lead first-of-a-kind pilot builds, capture lessons learned, and feed them back into designs before scale-out.
Own the handoff to Deployment: documentation, training, readiness reviews, and a supply plan that supports the volume ramp.
Track technical, schedule, and supply risks across new product lines; make trade-offs visible and drive decisions with engineering and leadership.
Build the NPI process itself, including templates, gate reviews, dashboards, and reporting, so new platforms land predictably as we grow.

About You

5+ years in technical program management, hardware NPI, or network engineering, with direct ownership of bringing new network hardware or architectures into production.
Experience at a hyperscaler, major network or silicon vendor, or ODM/OEM (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Meta, Google, Oracle/OCI, NVIDIA, Cisco, Arista, Broadcom), or a comparable large-scale environment.
Hands-on familiarity with hardware qualification: lab validation, interop testing, firmware and NOS lifecycle, defect triage, and phase-gate NPI processes.
Strong technical grounding in data center and cluster networking: Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, RoCE, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, optics and transceivers, and structured cabling.
Proven ability to drive vendors and cross-functional engineering teams to decisions when designs, schedules, and supply are still moving.
Comfortable working in ambiguity, defining process where none exists, and making clear calls on readiness.
Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
Willingness to travel to vendor labs and pilot sites as needed.

Nice to Have

NPI experience on networking for large GPU clusters, HPC, or AI training environments.
Experience qualifying 400G/800G/1.6T optics, co-packaged or linear-drive optics, or new SerDes generations.
Familiarity with HPC topologies (Fat Tree, Rail-optimized, Dragonfly) and NVIDIA Spectrum-X or Quantum InfiniBand platforms.
Exposure to network automation and test tooling (Python, Ansible, traffic generators such as IXIA/Keysight or Spirent).
Background in supply chain or manufacturing ramp for new hardware.
PMP, PgMP, or similar certification.

Why this role matters

Every new generation of GPU cluster depends on network hardware that has never run at our scale before. This role makes sure each new platform is proven before it reaches a site, so Deployment can build it fast and right the first time.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
ATI has been named "Best Places to Work in SC" from 2017 - 2026.

This is a full-time opportunity with benefits
ATI provides Medical, Dental and Vision Plan options
Flexible Spending Accounts, including health and dependent care accounts
403B Retirement Savings plan with a very competitive company contribution
Personal time-off (pre-loaded & accrued) plus 12 paid holiday-days
Life Insurance paid by ATI
Paid Parental Leave
Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Coverage paid by ATI
Employee Assistance Program
Tuition Reimbursement Program
Flexible work schedules

ATI's standard business hours are Monday-Friday, between 8 AM - 5 PM.

ATI builds and manages collaborations that conducts research and development of new technologies to solve our nation’s most pressing challenges. Our collaborations are custom-built teams of organizations from industry and academia that develop novel technologies for the federal government. Traditionally, these processes are complicated and burdensome. That’s where ATI comes in. We simplify and streamline processes to make it all work. When you work at ATI, you become a part of something larger than yourself. Our collective work – no matter what department or division you work in – ultimately enables the warfighter, saves lives, and diversifies the industrial base. At our core, ATI is a service organization. We are in service to others; it’s what we do, and it’s who we are.

Position Description

The Senior Program Manager supports ATI’s submarine and shipbuilding industrial base portfolio and related defense industrial base initiatives through senior program leadership or senior technical subject matter expertise. This position may be filled in one of two roles depending on program needs. In a program leadership role, the Senior Program Manager provides strategic, business, and operational leadership for a major program, portfolio, or mission-critical line of effort. In this role, the individual leads managers and cross-functional teams, engages senior Government and industry stakeholders, and drives execution, staffing, financial performance, contractual compliance, customer engagement, and portfolio outcomes at scale. In a senior technical SME role, the Senior Program Manager provides deep subject matter expertise across complex efforts that support ATI’s industrial base mission. In this role, the individual may contribute full time to technical strategy, implementation planning, technical evaluation, technology implementation, sponsor-facing technical advisory support, external engagement, and cross-project technical problem solving. Individuals in this role may or may not have direct project ownership.

Apply at ATI.ORG; we only accept applications submitted through our applicant tracking system.

**We offer a hybrid schedule (in-office & remote/work from home), fully remote or an onsite schedule and flexible hours. Candidates will need to reside near Charleston, SC to ensure work site flexibility. Fully remote work may be considered for qualified candidates residing outside of Charleston, SC.**

Essential Functions
Supports ATI’s submarine and shipbuilding industrial base mission in a high-visibility, multi-stakeholder environment.
Operates effectively in engagements involving Government sponsors, senior customer representatives, shipbuilders, academic institutions, industry stakeholders, performers, and ATI leadership, as required by assignment.
Contributes to strategic planning, execution, issue resolution, communications, and stakeholder engagement across assigned efforts.
Develops, reviews, executes, or technically assesses key program and project artifacts, deliverables, metrics, reports, and implementation activities, consistent with assigned responsibilities.
Prepares and delivers briefings, recommendations, technical reports, strategic communications, and related materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Drives sound judgment, operational discipline, and continuous improvement across assigned areas of responsibility.
Essential Functions for the Program Leadership Role
Provides strategic leadership for a major program, portfolio, or mission-critical line of effort, including responsibility for execution performance, resource alignment, customer satisfaction, portfolio health, and operational effectiveness.
Leads managers, project managers, technical staff, and cross-functional support personnel in the execution of complex portfolios and integrated lines of effort.
Guides program strategy and execution across project development, investment planning, scope definition, project award, performance management, implementation activities, and portfolio reporting.
Ensures disciplined execution of program and project contracts, agreements, deliverables, schedules, budgets, cost-share tracking where applicable, performance metrics, and reporting requirements.
Leads executive-level assessments of portfolio status, financial performance, risks, staffing, operational constraints, and strategic opportunities, and provides senior recommendations regarding portfolio composition, resource allocation, and performance improvement.
Establishes and maintains management controls, dashboards, reporting structures, operating rhythms, and escalation pathways needed to manage complex, high-visibility work.
Directs and mentors program management staff, including support for hiring, staff development, and workload balancing across the program.
Essential Functions for the Senior Technical SME Role
Provides senior technical leadership and subject matter expertise across complex government, industrial base, manufacturing, or research and development efforts.
Supports technical strategy, implementation planning, technical evaluation, technology implementation, and stakeholder engagement across one or more complex initiatives.
Contributes to sponsor-facing technical advisory work, technical interchanges, performer engagement, and technical assessment of approaches, risks, and implementation paths.
Supports implementation of design or process changes in production or shipyard settings, including assessment of technical feasibility, manufacturability, and transition considerations, as applicable.
Applies senior technical judgment to support problem solving, execution improvement, and cross-project integration across relevant mission or industrial base domains.
Supports technical transfer events, portfolio communications, strategic planning efforts, and external engagements through deep subject matter expertise.

Additional Responsibilities
May serve in a Deputy Director or equivalent senior leadership role.
Represents program leadership in executive-level customer interactions, strategic planning activities, and major program reviews.
Supports or leads proposal strategy, customer shaping, business development, and capture activities relevant to the assigned portfolio.
Performs other duties as assigned by division leadership or executive management.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree and eight or more related years of experience or equivalent combination of experience and training, or a Master’s degree and six or more related years of experience or equivalent combination of experience and training. A degree in Engineering, Science, Supply Chain, Technical Program Management, or a related field is preferred.

Project and process management experience is required. PMP certification is viewed favorably but is not required.

Exceptional communication skills, including executive presentations, technical reports, meeting leadership, and stakeholder management, are required.

Strong computer skills, including Excel skills and proficiency in MS Office Suite—Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Project—are desired.

For program leadership assignments, significant experience leading complex government, industrial base, research and development, manufacturing, or technology implementation programs is required. Demonstrated success leading managers and cross-functional teams in a multi-project environment is required. Strong experience in program and portfolio management, customer engagement, operational oversight, and staff leadership is required.

For senior technical SME assignments, significant experience providing advanced technical expertise, implementation support, technical evaluation, technology transition support, or sponsor-facing technical advisory support across complex government, industrial base, manufacturing, or research and development efforts is highly desirable.

Specific Skillsets of Interest

Experience includes shipbuilding, implementing design or process changes in production or shipyard settings, submarine industrial base initiatives, manufacturing technology development and implementation, strategic outsourcing, supplier development, supply chain management, and workforce development or technical training programs.

Additional desirable technical experience includes one or more of the following domains: robotics and automated manufacturing systems; additive manufacturing; materials and processes, including composites, metals, and ceramics; design and structural analysis; digital manufacturing ecosystems, including digital twin and digital thread; AI/ML; modeling and simulation; welding engineering; systems engineering; and inspection technologies or nondestructive testing methods such as ultrasonic inspection and digital radiography, particularly in naval manufacturing environments. A technical advanced degree in these fields is also highly desirable.

Experience supporting Other Transaction Authority/Other Transaction Agreement projects, prototype efforts, or industrial base investment portfolios is viewed favorably. Experience collaborating with Navy program offices, major shipbuilders, OEMs, and multi-organizational project teams is similarly valued.

Additional Requirements

Ability to travel to conferences, shipyards, industrial facilities, supplier sites, customer locations, and meetings is required. Weekend travel is very infrequent; however, it may be needed to support client needs for an early Monday or late Friday event.

This position will need the ability to access U.S.-only data systems—U.S. Citizenship is required and/or the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance may be required.

This position is subject to a background check that includes a review of criminal records. In reviewing an applicant’s criminal history, the company will consider prior criminal convictions that have a relationship to the job duties and responsibilities of the position. The company considers the nature of the crime, the time that has elapsed since the crime, and the job duties for the position at issue in making an individualized determination. Individuals may be excluded when the company determines, based on the above factors, that hiring, transferring, or promoting the applicant would pose an unreasonable risk to the business, its employees, or its customers and vendors.

If you are a qualified candidate, we encourage you to apply even if you have prior criminal conviction(s). Convictions will not automatically disqualify a candidate. However, conviction(s) will be considered and balanced against the age of the candidate at the time of the offense, time elapsed since the offense, type of offense, potential impacts on the work environment, sensitivity of the position(s) available/sought, and similar independent factors relevant to the employment requirements at ATI.

Must be either a U.S. Citizen by birth or naturalization.

Must successfully pass a background to access sensitive information and automated systems.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.

The Opportunity

An opportunity for an experienced real estate and project management professional who enjoys leading projects, collaborating with clients and project teams, and delivering high-quality life sciences facilities from early planning through completion.

At Brailsford & Dunlavey (B&D), we lead the planning, development, and management of the places that shape and strengthen communities—where people live, learn, work, and innovate. B&D partners with institutions, municipalities, and organizations to deliver complex real estate and capital projects through strategic advisory and program management services across the full project lifecycle.

B&D recently joined forces with Project Management Advisors (PMA), bringing together two nationally recognized leaders in program management and real estate advisory services. Together, the combined firm offers expanded capabilities across industries and end-to-end project delivery—from early-stage strategy through design, construction, and occupancy.

Our Life Sciences team supports the development, leasing, and delivery of laboratory, research, and biotech facilities across the country. We work closely with owners, developers, tenants, brokers, and project teams to deliver technically complex environments that support innovation and scientific discovery.

As a Project Manager, you will lead smaller-scale life sciences projects while serving as a trusted advisor to clients and a key liaison between ownership, design teams, contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders. You will oversee project planning, procurement, budgets, schedules, documentation, and project delivery activities while ensuring alignment with client goals and project objectives.

Check out our Life Science portfolio here: https://www.pmainc.com/projects/?order=most-recent&types=life-science

How You'll Contribute

Lead life sciences project management initiatives from early-stage planning through project completion, ensuring alignment with client goals, budgets, schedules, and quality expectations
Establish strong partnerships with clients and serve as a key liaison between owners, architects, engineers, contractors, brokers, and consultants
Review and evaluate project requirements, program goals, and design solutions to ensure alignment with owner objectives
Initiate and manage procurement efforts for design, construction, and consultant services
Draft, review, communicate, negotiate, and manage contractual documents for design, construction, and consultant professionals
Develop, maintain, and monitor project budgets, schedules, and web-based project controls while identifying potential risks and opportunities
Analyze budget and schedule impacts and provide recommendations to support project financial objectives
Oversee the development and review of architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and bid documents
Establish, lead, and document project meetings, ensuring clear communication and alignment among stakeholders
Provide regular project updates to clients, city officials, architects, engineers, contractors, and consultants while proactively identifying issues and solutions
Anticipate potential changes to project budgets and schedules and provide recommendations to mitigate risks and maintain project objectives
Coordinate value engineering exercises and evaluate alternatives with ownership teams
Identify project requirements and facilitate procurement of peer reviews and specialty consultants as needed
Direct and mentor Assistant Project Managers and other project team members when assigned
Coordinate with architects and project teams to monitor contractor and vendor activities and verify compliance with design specifications, schedules, and quality standards
Support contract administration activities, including contracts, purchase orders, and progress payment documentation
Observe and report on construction progress, project risks, and construction-related issues
Manage project closeout activities and ensure successful project completion
Support PMA’s business development efforts by participating in networking opportunities, proposal development, and client interviews

What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in project management, real estate development, construction, architecture, engineering, or related fields, with familiarity managing life sciences environments, including laboratory facilities, research spaces, GMP environments, clean rooms, or other specialized technical infrastructure preferred
Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, Urban Planning, or a related field
Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, procurement activities, and project controls
Understanding of design and construction processes, including architectural drawings, engineering documents, bidding, and contract administration
Experience coordinating and managing architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders
Ability to analyze project data, identify risks, and develop practical solutions to keep projects moving forward
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with clients and project teams
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail and organization

What Sets You Apart

You are a confident project leader who can independently manage projects while building trusted client relationships
You communicate clearly, professionally, and proactively with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams
You have strong business judgment and the ability to anticipate challenges before they impact project goals
You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage complex project information, budgets, and schedules
You enjoy solving problems, developing solutions, and keeping projects moving forward in dynamic environments
You are comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on project execution
You demonstrate integrity, professionalism, and accountability in all interactions
You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy partnering with diverse stakeholder groups
You are interested in the life sciences industry and the opportunity to support innovative spaces that advance scientific discovery

Why People Choose B&D

Impactful Mission

Be part of meaningful work that helps shape the places where people live, learn, heal, work, and connect.

Learning & Growth

We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning at every stage of your career.

Strong Culture

Entrepreneurial thinking, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, integrity, and excellence drive how we work together.

Robust Benefits

Comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement benefits, professional development support, paid time off, and more.

Apply Today!

To get started, our application process includes a resume, an optional (recommended) cover letter, and a short set of essential questions. We look forward to getting to know you!

ATI builds and manages collaborations that conducts research and development of new technologies to solve our nation’s most pressing challenges. Our collaborations are custom-built teams of organizations from industry and academia that develop novel technologies for the federal government. Traditionally, these processes are complicated and burdensome. That’s where ATI comes in. We simplify and streamline processes to make it all work. When you work at ATI, you become a part of something larger than yourself. Our collective work – no matter what department or division you work in – ultimately enables the warfighter, saves lives, and diversifies the industrial base. At our core, ATI is a service organization. We are in service to others; it’s what we do, and it’s who we are.

Position Description

The Program Manager II supports ATI’s submarine and shipbuilding industrial base portfolio and related defense industrial base programs through advanced program leadership or advanced technical subject matter expertise. This position may be filled in one of two roles depending on program needs.
In a program leadership role, the Program Manager II leads a complex portfolio segment, major line of effort, or strategically important group of projects. In this role, the individual coordinates cross-functional teams, aligns priorities across stakeholders, supports sponsor objectives, and drives execution across multiple simultaneous projects and initiatives. The Program Manager II may also serve in a deputy leadership capacity for assigned programs.
In a technical SME role, the Program Manager II contributes advanced subject matter expertise across one or more complex efforts. In this role, the individual may support technical planning, implementation, evaluation, transition activities, performer engagement, sponsor interaction, manufacturing or industrial base problem solving, and cross-project technical integration. Individuals in this role may or may not have direct project ownership.

Apply at ATI.ORG; we only accept applications submitted through our applicant tracking system.

**We offer a hybrid schedule (in-office & remote/work from home), fully remote or an onsite schedule and flexible hours. Candidates will need to reside near Charleston, SC to ensure work site flexibility. Fully remote work may be considered for qualified candidates residing outside of Charleston, SC.**

Essential Functions
Supports execution of ATI’s submarine and shipbuilding industrial base mission in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
Coordinates effectively across Government sponsors, shipbuilders, suppliers, academic institutions, technical performers, OEMs, lower-tier subcontractors, and internal ATI teams, as required by assignment.
Contributes to planning, execution, issue resolution, reporting, and stakeholder engagement across assigned efforts.
Develops, reviews, or supports execution of key program and project artifacts, including statements of work, scopes, schedules, budgets, deliverables, technical reports, status reports, metrics, and required approvals, consistent with assigned responsibilities.
Prepares and delivers briefings, dashboards, written analyses, recommendations, and related materials for ATI leadership and Government stakeholders.
Drives sound judgment, operational discipline, and process improvement across assigned areas of responsibility.
Essential Functions for the Program Leadership Role
Leads management of complex portfolios, multi-project efforts, or integrated lines of effort involving multiple stakeholders, performers, and technical disciplines.
Directs project development and execution activities, including startup, solicitation support, issue resolution, reporting, transition activities, closeout, and project award acceleration efforts.
Establishes and maintains program-level insight into schedule, cost, risks, resource allocation, dependencies, and performance trends, and recommends corrective actions or replanning as needed.
Coordinates cross-functional support from contracts, finance, technical staff, compliance, communications, and operations teams to ensure effective execution and resolution of programmatic issues.
Supervises and mentors project managers and program staff, including oversight of workload planning, prioritization, staff development, and performance.
Supports program reviews, technical interchange meetings, strategic planning sessions, portfolio assessments, and sponsor engagements.
Helps define staffing needs, operating rhythms, reporting structures, and management controls for assigned portfolios or lines of effort.
Essential Functions for the Technical SME Role
Provides advanced technical guidance and subject matter expertise across complex government, industrial base, manufacturing, or research and development efforts.
Supports technical planning, implementation, technology insertion, evaluation, transition, and stakeholder engagement across one or more assigned efforts.
Contributes to technical interchanges, sponsor-facing discussions, and performer coordination to support execution of technically complex work.
Supports implementation of design or process changes in production or shipyard settings, including evaluation of technical feasibility, manufacturability, and transition considerations, as applicable.
Applies advanced technical judgment to support problem solving, risk management, and execution improvement across relevant mission or industrial base domains.
Serves as a Project Technical Representative or comparable technical representative on pertinent projects, as needed.

Additional Responsibilities
May serve in a Deputy Director or comparable leadership support role.
May backfill the Technical Director or other senior leadership, as needed, for internal and external meetings.
Supports business development, opportunity shaping, proposal planning, and customer engagement activities.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree and eight or more related years of experience or equivalent combination of experience and training, or a Master’s degree and six or more related years of experience or equivalent combination of experience and training. A degree in Engineering, Science, Supply Chain, Technical Program Management, or a related field is preferred.

Project and process management experience is required. PMP certification is viewed favorably but is not required. Experience with government programs is viewed favorably but is not required.

Strong communication skills, including presentations, technical reports, meeting management, and group management, are required.

Strong computer skills, including intermediate to advanced Excel skills and proficiency in MS Office Suite—Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Project—are desired.

For program leadership assignments, demonstrated experience managing complex programs or portfolios, supervising project managers, and coordinating across technical, contractual, and financial functions is required.

For technical SME assignments, demonstrated experience providing advanced technical expertise, implementation support, technical evaluation, or technology transition support across complex government, industrial base, manufacturing, or research and development efforts is highly desirable.

Specific Skillsets of Interest

Experience includes shipbuilding, implementing design or process changes in production or shipyard settings, submarine industrial base initiatives, manufacturing technology development and implementation, strategic outsourcing, supplier development, supply chain management, and workforce development or technical training programs.

Additional desirable technical experience includes one or more of the following domains: robotics and automated manufacturing systems; additive manufacturing; materials and processes, including composites, metals, and ceramics; design and structural analysis; digital manufacturing ecosystems, including digital twin and digital thread; AI/ML; modeling and simulation; welding engineering; systems engineering; and inspection technologies or nondestructive testing methods such as ultrasonic inspection and digital radiography, particularly in naval manufacturing environments. A technical advanced degree in these fields is also highly desirable.

Experience supporting Other Transaction Authority/Other Transaction Agreement projects, prototype efforts, or industrial base investment portfolios is viewed favorably. Experience collaborating with Navy program offices, major shipbuilders, OEMs, and multi-organizational project teams is similarly valued.

Additional Requirements

Ability to travel to conferences, shipyards, industrial facilities, customer sites, supplier locations, and meetings is required. Weekend travel is very infrequent; however, it may be needed to support client needs for an early Monday or late Friday event.

This position will need the ability to access U.S.-only data systems—U.S. Citizenship is required and/or the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance may be required.

In reviewing an applicant’s criminal history, the company will consider prior criminal convictions that have a relationship to the job duties and responsibilities of the position. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager – Networking NPI
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead New Product Introduction (NPI) for networking across Nscale's US GPU cloud. You'll own the path from a new network platform, architecture, or vendor being selected to it being proven, documented, and ready to deploy at scale.

That covers new switch and NIC generations, 800G and next-generation optics, new cluster fabric designs, and new data center and WAN reference architectures. You'll work closely with Network Architecture and Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, vendors, and our Deployment organization, which takes what you qualify and builds it across our sites. The role involves some travel to vendor labs and US pilot sites.

What You'll be Doing

Own the NPI program for new networking platforms, from vendor selection and early samples through lab qualification, pilot build, and release to Deployment.
Build NPI plans with clear phase gates (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), entry and exit criteria, owners, and dates.
Drive qualification and validation of switches, NICs/DPUs, optics, cables, and network operating systems, including interoperability, performance, burn-in, and failure testing.
Run the vendor engagement on new products: roadmap alignment, sample allocation, bug and RMA tracking, firmware and NOS release readiness, and escalation of blocking defects.
Partner with Network Architecture to turn new designs into production-ready reference builds, golden configs, BOMs, cabling and rack standards, and acceptance test plans.
Lead first-of-a-kind pilot builds, capture lessons learned, and feed them back into designs before scale-out.
Own the handoff to Deployment: documentation, training, readiness reviews, and a supply plan that supports the volume ramp.
Track technical, schedule, and supply risks across new product lines; make trade-offs visible and drive decisions with engineering and leadership.
Build the NPI process itself, including templates, gate reviews, dashboards, and reporting, so new platforms land predictably as we grow.

About You

5+ years in technical program management, hardware NPI, or network engineering, with direct ownership of bringing new network hardware or architectures into production.
Experience at a hyperscaler, major network or silicon vendor, or ODM/OEM (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Meta, Google, Oracle/OCI, NVIDIA, Cisco, Arista, Broadcom), or a comparable large-scale environment.
Hands-on familiarity with hardware qualification: lab validation, interop testing, firmware and NOS lifecycle, defect triage, and phase-gate NPI processes.
Strong technical grounding in data center and cluster networking: Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, RoCE, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, optics and transceivers, and structured cabling.
Proven ability to drive vendors and cross-functional engineering teams to decisions when designs, schedules, and supply are still moving.
Comfortable working in ambiguity, defining process where none exists, and making clear calls on readiness.
Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
Willingness to travel to vendor labs and pilot sites as needed.

Nice to Have

NPI experience on networking for large GPU clusters, HPC, or AI training environments.
Experience qualifying 400G/800G/1.6T optics, co-packaged or linear-drive optics, or new SerDes generations.
Familiarity with HPC topologies (Fat Tree, Rail-optimized, Dragonfly) and NVIDIA Spectrum-X or Quantum InfiniBand platforms.
Exposure to network automation and test tooling (Python, Ansible, traffic generators such as IXIA/Keysight or Spirent).
Background in supply chain or manufacturing ramp for new hardware.
PMP, PgMP, or similar certification.

Why this role matters

Every new generation of GPU cluster depends on network hardware that has never run at our scale before. This role makes sure each new platform is proven before it reaches a site, so Deployment can build it fast and right the first time.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager
jobs.description:
MS Dynamics AX / 365 Business Systems Analyst/Project Manager

Direct Hire

Addison, TX (Hybrid)

We are seeking an experienced Techno-Functional Business Systems Analyst / Project Manager to play a key role in an upcoming Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) migration and upgrade initiative.

This individual will serve as a primary liaison between internal business stakeholders, IT teams, developers, and our selected implementation partner. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience supporting or leading Dynamics AX to D365 upgrade/migration projects, with the ability to evaluate, coordinate, and implement moves, adds, changes, enhancements, configurations, and customizations within the ERP environment.
This is a permanent role that will support the organization throughout the implementation lifecycle and transition into an ongoing D365 application support, administration, enhancement, and optimization role following go-live.
We are looking to bring this individual onboard prior to project kickoff so they can gain a strong understanding of our current AX environment, business processes, integrations, data, customizations, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

AX to D365 Migration & Project Delivery: Serve as an internal subject matter resource throughout the Dynamics AX to D365 F&O migration, partnering with the implementation vendor, internal IT, developers, and business stakeholders from discovery through go-live and stabilization.
Application Moves, Adds & Changes: Own and coordinate ongoing moves, adds, changes, enhancements, and modifications across the AX/D365 application environment. Evaluate business requests, determine system impact, document requirements, define acceptance criteria, and oversee changes through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Configuration & Customization: Evaluate whether business requirements can be addressed through standard D365 configuration, workflow changes, extensions, integrations, reporting changes, or custom development. Partner with technical resources on required customizations while helping the organization minimize unnecessary customization of the D365 platform.
Business & Technical Requirements: Lead requirements-gathering sessions to document current-state processes and define future-state requirements. Translate business needs into detailed functional requirements, technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and system specifications.
Application Enhancement Management: Manage requests for new functionality and enhancements following established change-management processes. Analyze requested changes for impacts to modules, integrations, data, security roles, workflows, reporting, and other business processes.
Fit-Gap & Customization Analysis: Perform fit-gap analysis between the organization's existing AX functionality and D365 capabilities. Identify which legacy AX customizations should be retained, redesigned, replaced with native D365 functionality, or retired as part of the migration.
Project Management & Vendor Coordination: Help manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and deliverables. Act as a knowledgeable internal advocate when working with the D365 implementation partner and challenge proposed solutions when they do not align with business or technical requirements.
Functional Configuration: Participate in the configuration and ongoing support of applicable D365 modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory Management, and Warehouse Management.
Technical & Integration Coordination: Work closely with developers, architects, and vendors on interfaces, integrations, APIs, data entities, workflows, reports, batch processes, and custom extensions, ensuring technical solutions align with business requirements.
Data Migration & Mapping: Support source-to-target mapping, legacy AX data analysis, cleansing, transformation, conversion, financial reconciliation, validation, and cutover activities.
Testing & Release Validation: Develop and coordinate test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and post-deployment validation. Ensure moves, adds, changes, configurations, and customizations are properly tested before being introduced into production.
Security & Role Changes: Partner with IT and business leadership to manage changes to D365 security roles, duties, privileges, user access, workflows, and segregation-of-duties requirements as the organization evolves.
Cutover & Go-Live: Support release planning, cutover, go-live readiness, deployment validation, issue resolution, and post-production hypercare.
Documentation & Change Management: Maintain documentation for business processes, system configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, application changes, test results, and operating procedures.
Post-Go-Live Application Ownership: Following implementation, serve as a key resource for D365 application support, production issues, moves/adds/changes, configuration changes, enhancements, customizations, upgrades, release management, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Experience participating in or leading an AX to D365 upgrade, migration, or transformation project.
Demonstrated experience supporting application moves, adds, changes, configurations, enhancements, and customizations within Dynamics AX or D365.
Ability to determine when a business requirement should be solved through configuration versus customization or development.
Experience gathering and translating requirements between business users, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and implementation partners.
Strong understanding of the ERP lifecycle, including requirements, fit-gap analysis, configuration, customization, development coordination, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and production support.
Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and production validation.
Experience with ERP data migration, mapping, reconciliation, and legacy-system conversion.
Strong project management skills, including management of scope, timelines, risks, issues, dependencies, change requests, and vendor deliverables.

D365 configuration and application administration
AX-to-D365 upgrade/migration projects
D365 extensions and customizations
Workflows and business processes
Integrations, interfaces, APIs, and data entities
Azure DevOps
Lifecycle Services (LCS)
Power Platform / Power Automate
Power BI and D365 reporting
SQL and data analysis
Security roles, duties, and privileges
SIT, UAT, regression testing, and release management

Position Summary
The Information Security Manager leads the organization's security operations and risk program. The role oversees security monitoring and incident response, manages the SOC and its vendors, reports on security posture to executive leadership, and ensures the organization meets its compliance and audit obligations. It combines hands-on operational oversight with governance and communication.

Key ResponsibilitiesSecurity Monitoring and Incident Response

Oversee 24/7 security monitoring and threat detection, and review, validate, and prioritize alerts from the managed SOC, SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, email, and network security tools.

Act as the internal escalation point for security incidents, including phishing, malware, account compromise, data exposure, and policy violations.

Lead incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

Coordinate remediation with IT Operations, Helpdesk, M365 and network teams, legal, HR, communications, and third-party vendors.

Maintain detailed incident documentation, timelines, and post-incident summaries.

Maintain and test incident response plans, runbooks, and tabletop exercises.

SOC and Vendor Management

Manage the internal or outsourced SOC, including MSSP and MDR providers, and serve as the primary technical point of contact for the managed SOC/MDR provider.

Validate SOC findings, challenge false positives, and ensure alerts are actionable and risk-based.

Participate in tuning discussions to improve alert quality and reduce noise.

Define, monitor, and enforce vendor SLAs, ensuring incidents meet defined response expectations.

Evaluate and select security vendors and tools, and manage contracts, renewals, and budgets.

Conduct regular vendor reviews and escalate performance issues.

Reporting and Executive Communication

Produce recurring security reports for the VP of IT, executive leadership, and board members, including incident summaries, threat trends and metrics, and risk posture and exposure overview.

Translate technical security data into clear, non-technical business risk language to support decision-making and budget requests.

Provide ad-hoc briefings following significant incidents or emerging threats.

Risk, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

Run risk assessments and maintain the risk register and remediation tracking.

Ensure alignment with applicable frameworks and regulations (e.g., HIPAA, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, as relevant), including providing operational evidence, incident data, and security metrics to support compliance efforts.

Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and runbooks.

Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and opportunities to improve detection, response, and remediation processes.

Partner with IT leadership to improve overall security maturity and drive the security roadmap.

Lead security awareness and training initiatives.

Audits

Serve as the primary contact for internal, external, and regulatory audits.

Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, and responses to audit findings.

Track remediation of audit findings through to closure.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

6-10 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, or incident response, including at least 2 years in a lead or management role.

Proven experience responding to real-world security incidents and hands-on SOC operations experience.

Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, LogRhythm), EDR/XDR solutions (e.g., Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike), and email security, identity security, and endpoint tools.

Experience managing third-party security vendors and service providers.

Working knowledge of HIPAA, PHI protection, and healthcare security expectations, as well as other security frameworks and compliance requirements.

Experience supporting audits and managing remediation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-level summaries.

Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment during security events.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with a managed SOC or MDR provider.

Healthcare or other regulated-industry background (e.g., finance, government).

Microsoft 365 security experience (Defender, Entra ID, Purview, etc.).

Experience with vulnerability management platforms and cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Relevant certifications (preferred, not required): CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, GCIA, GCED, GCIH, Security+, SC-200 or similar.

Master's degree or MBA.

Core Competencies

Leadership and team development

Incident ownership and decision-making

Risk-based thinking

Clear executive communication

Calm, methodical response under pressure

Strong collaboration across IT and leadership teams

Vendor and budget management

Strategic thinking and process improvement

Working Conditions

Participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents.

Occasional travel for audits, vendor meetings, or conferences [if applicable].
